From 02-07-1426:  
July has 31 days, so days left in July = 31 - 2 = 29 days.  
278 - 29 = 249 days left.  
August (31), September (30), October (31), November (30), December (31) = 153 days total.

1427 is common year (not divisible by 4). January 31, February 28 → 59 days.  
96 - 59 = 37 days into March.

Actually:  
July 2 + 29 days = July 31.  
Remaining 278 - 29 = 249 days.  
August to December: 31+30+31+30+31 = 153 days.  
249 - 153 = 96 days into 1427.  
January 31, February 28 = 59 days.  
96 - 59 = 37 days into March.  
March has 31 days, so 37 days into March = April 6 (since March 31 + 6 days = April 6).  

Thus new date: 1427-04-06.
